title: Awakenings
description: A simple mod that implements the breaths mechanics based on Brandon Sanderson's book: Warbreaker
body:
# Awakenings! ✨📘

Bring the vibrant magic of Warbreaker to your Minecraft world!
This mod introduces the mystical system of BioChromatic Breath, the divine power of Elevations, and the mysterious blade Nightblood—faithfully reimagined for NeoForge.

 

This mod draws directly from Brandon Sanderson’s Warbreaker book, blending deep lore with Minecrafty mechanics. Whether you’re a fan of the Cosmere or just want or if you want to explore a new magic system, this mod offers a fresh experience.
 
## Features 🔥
- Collect and store Breath in your own Breath Reservoir killing entities.

- Gain Heightenings (Elevations) at specific Breath thresholds, unlocking passive effects!

- Wield the sentient, black sword Nightblood, a powerful sword, which consumes your breaths to function!

- In multiplayer you can kill other players to steal some of their breaths!

## Requirements 📦
Version 1.21.3+ -> NeoForge 21.3.76 or superior

## About Us 🙋
We are SteelCode, a passionate team inspired by the work of Sanderson. Stay tuned for the latest updates on our new website and upcoming projects by visiting the final notes section. We sincerely hope you enjoy your trip with us! 🎉

## Final Notes & Credits 🚀
Obviously read all Brandon Sanderson's books. All Brandon books are really good.

This mod, although we consider that this is a early version, it is still under construction, but this version is functional and playable in both singleplayer and multiplayer.
 If you find any bugs or have any ideas for improvements, please let us know via our github (Issues Tab) or via Discord. If you want to know what we are working on, you can see the "Future Improvements" section from github README.md

### Stay Connected with Us
Join our Discord guild to stay in touch and receive updates. Also you can check our new website.
